notes.title: Fallen Legion Celebrates Its Fifth Anniversary
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31247536/9e021f740628efa7b338abc6d38b1c26b0383f5c.png[/img]
Fallen Legion turned five this year and to celebrate we updated our lighting fast action RPG with even more content. The latest version of the game adds Aleister and Jacquine, two new Exemplars from Fallen Legion Revenants, as playable characters. You’ll also see new hand drawn illustrations for both Princess Cecille and the Legate’s stories.

We heard from PC players that they would like to have keyboard mapping and we added it in along with support for more controllers plus gamepad remapping. Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory also supports Twitch interactivity and you can let Twitch chat decide the fate of Fenumia. When Twitch Interactivity is enabled, your viewers can type these commands in Twitch chat:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31247536/6c0b0c0c2a0277d7870eef516771b7f564aeaf7e.png[/img]

[b]!Pick red[/b] – chooses the red decision and buff
[b]!Pick blue[/b] – chooses the blue decision and buff
[b]!Pick green[/b] – chooses the green decision and buff

The game will select a final story choice from the player’s choice and all of Twitch chat’s choices and the story continues from there.

This build was a major update for Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory based on the PlayStation 5 and Xbox versions of the game. We included the Fallen Legion+, the original PC release, and the previous version of Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory as separate, unaltered games in the same directory. If you have saved data from an earlier release, you can load it and continue your game.

fallenlegion.exe – runs Fallen Legion+
fallenlegion-rtg.exe – runs the previous version of Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory

Working on the Fallen Legion series has been an incredible journey. Thank you for all of the support, perfect blocks, and high combos!

notes.title: Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory arrives on Steam as a free update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31247536/13ee32b054823ec539e69703cd383d6189a04f51.png[/img]

Bringing Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory to Steam was a bigger challenge than we anticipated. Rise to Glory uses a different codebase than Fallen Legion+ and integrating the extra content led to bugs. We were determined to do it and the sole programmer that built Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory for Nintendo Switch rebuilt the game for PC.

If you have Fallen Legion+, you also have Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory! If you want to play the original release, Fallen Legion+, please go to the directory where the game is installed and run [b]fallenlegion.exe[/b]. The update adds [b]fallenlegion-rtg.exe[/b] which plays Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory. Unfortunately, save data is incompatible between the two versions.

Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory has:
-	Five bonus playable characters including the elusive Succubus pictured here.
-	Face the Alarune, Prince Thuradal and Ignis in new boss battles.
-	More levels and story branches.
-	A Japanese voiceover option starring Shizuka Ishikami as Cecille, Hidenori Takahashi as the Legate, Kengo Kawanishi as the Grimoire, Ai Kakuma as Antoinette and Shinya Fukumatsu as Maurice.
-	English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese language options.

[previewyoutube=uuTodzRSKKg;full][/previewyoutube]

We hope you enjoy finding Fallen Legion: Rise to Glory’s secret characters and new story routes!

notes.title: Fallen Legion+ updated with Japanese localization and improved combat flow
notes.notes:
We have a new patch ready for Fallen Legion+ and includes a Japanese translation!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31247536/1dc10a0811bbaa8ff3b5fc963258011eb55cb3ff.png[/img]

You can play both stories with Japanese text by selecting the language in the main menu. We also tweaked the code base to squash bugs and improve the game’s framerate and performance for PC. 

Tweaks:
-	The combat core was reprogrammed to be a lot smoother.
-	Player deathblows and enemy spells have a better framerate on PC.
-	Projectiles and ranged attacks are smoother too.
-	Fixed a bug where the game could have a soft lock during dialogue sequences while running in windowed mode.
-	Fixed a bug where Swift Accelerando gemstones would not show correctly in some languages.

Thank you for playing Fallen Legion+. We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy exploring Fenumia!

notes.title: Unknown Pleasures: Five more of the best new games on Steam
notes.notes:
It’s that time of the year when joyless, faintly plastic robots insist that you forego the few pleasures January has to offer, calling you a big lazy drunk and demanding you join their dull, weight-obsessed ranks. But not here, friends! This is where we find new joy. It’s Unknown Pleasures.

This week we finish off the knock-off Baileys with button-mashing Empire management, queer aristocratic romance, and murderous teenaged narcissists.

Fallen Legion+ includes two PS4 games, Fallen Legion: Sins of an Empire and Fallen Legion: Flames of Rebellion bundled together. In Sins of an Empire you join Princess Cecille (voiced by Xanthe Huynh) as she fights to save her crumbling kingdom while Flames of Rebellion puts you in control of her rival, Legatus Laendur (voiced by Darrel Delfin).

notes.title: Fallen Legion is coming to Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31247536/11cd2b495df6cb310db363ddbb6d8490a6cc6f14.png[/img]

Get ready to rule an empire and crush your monstrous hordes as Fallen Legion is coming to Steam on January 5, 2018!

Will you join Princess Cecille on her quest to restore her crumbling kingdom or will you seize control of it with Legatus Laendur. Fallen Legion+ includes both epic games, Fallen Legion: Sins of an Empire and Fallen Legion: Flames of Rebellion, in one package for Steam.

We also localized Fallen Legion’s story from English into Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Bahasa Indonesia for Steam’s global audience. The Russian localization is being done by our friends at The Most Games who worked on esteemed RPGs like The Witcher 3 and Masquerada: Songs and Shadows.

Fallen Legion will launch with an option to play the game with a gamepad or keyboard, Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud saves.
